module: Creates the shadow blur filter of basic lighting: two ShaderData (BL_ShadowFilterShaderV and BL_ShadowFilterShaderH, same compute shader shadowFilter.cs.hlsl with BLUR_DIR = (1,0) then (0,1)) and a PostEffect "BL_ShadowFilterPostFx" that chains the two passes. Loaded by lighting/basic/init.lua. No exported function.
notes: The variable of the second pass is also named bl_ShadowFilterShaderH in the code but refers to a PostEffect (reused name); it is registered without a name.
The shader named "...V" receives the horizontal direction (1,0) and the "...H" the vertical (0,1): the suffixes do not match the actual direction.
